issue_request: FHIR-41552 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the Search documentation. It reported that adjacent sections both used the title and anchor Canonical Identifiers at search.html#identifiercanonical, and the approved resolution was to remove the extra header in the middle of the content.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by git commit 955cbe2a7783cd0d7958bf02a390b9c766dbd7cb, which removed the duplicate identifiercanonical anchor and Canonical Identifiers h5 from source/search.html. Jira also records that the fix was merged through HL7/fhir pull request 3442.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-12-09 confirm that the second heading should not exist and that the correction was to remove the extra header. Bounded Jira and Zulip searches found no conflicting later decision for the duplicate-heading problem; FHIR-54051 is a separate Triaged request about subdividing canonical identifier guidance and is not final application scope for this audit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/search.html has one Canonical Identifiers table-of-contents link, one identifiercanonical anchor, and one Canonical Identifiers h5 before the canonical identifier prose, so the duplicate header and anchor reported by FHIR-41552 are already gone from the active Search documentation source.

related_jiras.note: A Jira search for identifiercanonical found this later Triaged request about subdividing canonical identifiers into a dedicated chaining section; it is broader, unresolved application scope and not part of the duplicate-heading correction.
